page.overview:
Who is Desmond Hart?

Bashar Desmond Hart was a soldier with an enigmatic past, who sought to gain Emperor Javicco Corrino's trust at the expense of the Sisterhood. He was later revealed to be the love child of Orry Atreides and Tula Harkonnen.

A charismatic soldier with an enigmatic past who seeks to gain the Emperor’s trust.

Desmond was born on Wallach IX, to Tula Harkonnen, who'd been impregnated by Orry Atreides the night before she killed him. Knowing he had tremendous potential and not wanting him to be exploited for that by Valya, Tula pretended he died and had him swapped with a stillborn infant with Francesca's help.

Little is known about his life after this, but before the series begins he takes twelve tours on Arrakis, a feat since most barely survive their first.
